item.title: Toti Rejects Overseas Warship Building for US-Based Foreign Shipyards
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
Nominated Navy undersecretary William Toti is breaking ranks with the White House, pitching foreign-built shipyards on US soil instead of constructing warships overseas. Here is what this means for American naval industrial capacity.
[SPLIT] ⚡ The strategy explicitly rejects the administration's push to build core surface combatants in overseas yards like those in South Korea and Japan. [SPLIT] ⚡ Toti supports utilizing foreign yards solely for auxiliary vessels, mirroring the Arctic Security Cutter 'Finland model.' item.title: The Succession Battle Shaping the House Armed Services Committee
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
With Rep. Mike Rogers stepping down, a high-stakes leadership battle is brewing on the House Armed Services Committee between Trent Kelly and Ronny Jackson. What does this mean for Pentagon oversight and defense authorization? Find out inside.
[SPLIT] ⚡ Reps. Trent Kelly and Ronny Jackson are the primary contenders, both leveraging military backgrounds and ties to President Trump. [SPLIT] ⚡ Incoming Chairman Adam Smith faces pressure from within his party to launch investigations into Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and the Pentagon.
